insight: Acquired by Grammarly in July 2025; that October the combined company renamed itself Superhuman, spanning Mail, Coda, and Grammarly.
name: Superhuman Mail
tagline: Keyboard-first AI email client for Gmail and Outlook, built for inbox zero.
description: An AI-native email client for Gmail and Outlook accounts, known for sub-100ms keyboard-driven interactions, split-inbox triage, and AI that drafts replies in your own voice. Now part of the Superhuman Suite — alongside Grammarly, Coda, and the Superhuman Go assistant — from the company formerly known as Grammarly. Mail is included only in the Business plan ($33/member/month annual) and up; there is no standalone email subscription anymore.
edge: The speed benchmark for email — sub-100ms keyboard-first triage plus AI drafting in your voice, where most AI email peers bolt chat onto a slower client.
pros: AI drafts match your writing voice
cons: No standalone Mail plan — Business tier only
Suite bundling if you only want email

references.title: Grammarly acquires AI email client Superhuman
